openQuestions.question: Do headways (T1/T2 180 s, S1 120 s) and dwells (trams 15 s, sky rail 20 s) stand? The GDD gives none; they are starting values from Pulse.
openQuestions.why: They set the wait half of the boarding price (average wait is about half the headway, worst case a full headway).

openQuestions.question: Does the walk between linked stops (T1/circus to S1/circus is about 120 m; T1/records to T2/market) count as part of a journey's time?
openQuestions.why: Interchange walking time is not in the timetable. Journeys here are single-line, so the cross-line price is undecided.

openQuestions.question: Does boarding cost anything beyond wait plus ride, and do services run the whole mission clock?
openQuestions.why: GDD §02 says time only, with no fare. Operating hours and any extra cost are not specified, so none is invented.

openQuestions.question: Should T1 and T2 be extended past the sheet (Southside, Crown Road west, Harbour Road north)?
openQuestions.why: Termini are off-sheet, so the timetable only covers the listed stops. Datum's open question on the tram terminal and the sky rail loop also bears on this.

notes: Speeds (starting values [S]): trams 6 m/s (about 22 km/h, street running with stops 300-500 m apart); sky rail 8 m/s (about 29 km/h, short station spacing of 200-250 m). Run sec = chainage gap / speed, rounded to whole seconds, with acceleration and braking folded in.
Journey sec = ride time plus the dwell at each intermediate stop. It excludes the wait for the first service. Wait is 0 to one headway: T1 and T2 up to 180 s, S1 up to 120 s.
Run times are the same in both directions because the lines are double track. Reverse journeys have the same sec as the forward ones listed. All journeys are single-line, so via is empty.
The S1 skyport loop and the off-sheet termini are not timetabled. The chainage gaps given stop at Skyport, Terraces, Parade and Sunset Way.
The T1 Crown Circus to S1 Crown Circus interchange is about 120 m, within the 150 m standard. The plan notes list it as the one interchange, yet T1/records to T2/market is also tagged as one.
